title: 0.5.2 packaged app on a GitHub Apple silicon runner
passed_steps: Extract and verify the delivered app
Packaged native renderer and real window
failed_step: Sustained packaged combat, camera and audio (stall gates)

1.failure: Combat GUI updates stalled: one 94.6 ms app update interval; the frame cost 0.6 ms and the GUI's 14.4 ms timer wait returned after 92.8 ms (78 ms OS oversleep) with nothing moving

2.failure: Combat stalls up to 210 ms presented; Ruby updates cost 0.4-9 ms while native frames show wall time far above CPU time (layout 179.5 ms wall / 7.5 ms CPU, apply 54.3 ms wall / 0.2 ms CPU): the processes were waiting, not computing

history: The same stall gates failed on the 0.5.1 performance branches that became 0.5.1 (perf/integration, perf/mac-cadence, perf/zoom: 'combat: a frame stalled', 'Combat GUI updates stalled', 'pan: a frame stalled'); only one of the previous twelve runs passed. The package smoke's 'Terrain lost on resize' failure also occurred before (run 38330816143) and on main during this check; 0.5.2 fixes its cause (starting props sliding onto grubs).
comparison_0_5_1: macos-runner-0.5.1.json after_0_5_1: combat 16.31 / p95 20.61 ms, pan 16.99 / 19.72 ms, zoom 24.13 / 51.92 ms.
interpretation: Unchanged 0.5.1 failed the same stall gate on the same runner class within the hour, with comparable means. 0.5.2's means match it (combat 15.95-17.13 vs 16.52 ms, pan 16.67-16.84 vs 16.66 ms, zoom 19.39-27.62 vs 21.72 ms); the isolated stalls are shared-VM waits, not a weapons-sweep regression. The owner's M3 Pro remains the acceptance check.
